issuing_body: Personal Information Protection Commission (PIPC), Republic of Korea
covered_actors: enterprises and institutions adopting AI technology
implementation_notes: The model is non-binding guidance ('참고') developed through the AI Privacy Public-Private Policy Council. It covers the full AI lifecycle including pre-training, fine-tuning, and deployment. Future sector-specific guidance for small organizations and startups is planned. The document explicitly states entities may apply it according to their individual circumstances, and it will be updated as law, regulation, and technology evolve.
